back: The movement for Italian unity and independence from about 1815 to 1870.
Secret societies that plotted for constitutions and national freedom; their revolts in 1820-21 and 1831 were crushed.

front: What did Cavour and Napoleon III agree at Plombières (1858)?
back: France would help Piedmont drive Austria from northern Italy and receive Savoy and Nice.
Napoleon III made an armistice with Austria; Piedmont gained Lombardy but not Venetia.

front: When did the Thousand land in Sicily?
back: 11 May 1860 at Marsala; Garibaldi entered Naples on 7 September 1860.

front: When did Italy gain Venetia and Rome?
back: Venetia in 1866 after the Austro-Prussian War; Rome on 20 September 1870 after the French garrison left.

front: Why did the 1848-49 revolutions fail in Italy?
back: Austria defeated Piedmont, France restored the Pope, and the revolutionaries were divided.

front: What did Mazzini contribute to unification?
back: He inspired a generation with the idea of a united republic, but his uprisings failed.

front: Why was unification incomplete in the south?
back: Peasants gained little, landlords kept their land, taxes and conscription rose, and the gap between north and south persisted.
